CAN_AO.title: Can Ao
CAN_AO.description: The Azure Luan Heaven Phoenix of the Tianfeng Empire. Loss is his fuel; every sacrifice stokes the fire of his return.
CAN_AO.cardsModifierDescription: Add Can Ao cards to your deck.
CAN_AO.eventDeathPrevention: The Heaven Phoenix refuses to fall.
CAN_AO.bestiaryKillQuote: The empire's debt is paid in blood.
CAN_AO.unlockText: Complete a run as {Prerequisite} to unlock Can Ao.
CAN_AO.goldMonologue: [sine][orange]Riches buried in the old empire's ruins... reclaimed at last.[/orange][/sine]
CAN_AO.aromaPrinciple: [sine][orange]Ashes could not bow me. A fragrance will not.[/orange][/sine]
